note: Every design.css custom property resolved on :root of the shell page (getComputedStyle, var() substituted; colours probed through `color: var(--x)`, lengths through margin-left, times through transition-duration). Columns = theme keys (system-light/-dark = no data-theme on a light/dark OS; hearth-dark = Hearth chosen on a dark OS; the named ones on a light OS). kinds: tokens whose value differs for a kid or kiosk profile. frameDiffs: tokens an app document resolves differently from the shell in the same job (app-local overrides).
